test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In September 2024, L&T Semiconductor Technologies (SiLT) signed an agreement with which of the following companies to co-develop advanced processors for edge devices, hybrid cloud systems and areas like mobility, industrial, energy and servers?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**IBM**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **L&T Semiconductor Technologies** (SiLT) signed a partnership agreement with **IBM** in **September 2024**.
 
• This collaboration aims to co-develop **advanced processors** for **edge devices, hybrid cloud systems**, and areas like **mobility, industrial, energy, and servers.**
 
• **IBM** is a globally renowned technology company that specializes in **hardware, software, and cutting-edge technology solutions**, such as **AI, cloud computing, and quantum computing.**
 
• The focus of the partnership is to leverage **IBM's expertise** in processor development and **SiLT's capabilities** in semiconductor technology to address the growing demand for innovative solutions in these sectors.
 
• This collaboration is expected to foster technological advancements and boost **India's semiconductor industry**, aligning with the country's ambition to become a global hub for semiconductor manufacturing.
 
• **Edge devices** are critical components in modern computing systems, enabling **real-time data processing** closer to the source, thereby reducing latency and improving efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Nvidia**__

 __
 
• **Nvidia** is a leading company in **graphics processing units (GPUs)** and AI hardware.
 
• Nvidia is known for its contributions to **gaming technology** and its role in advancing **AI development** through platforms like **CUDA**.
 
• Although Nvidia is a key player in the technology sector, it is not directly involved in this specific collaboration with L&T Semiconductor Technologies.
 
 
 
• **Intel**__
 __
 
• **Intel** is one of the largest semiconductor chip manufacturers globally, known for its **processors** and innovations in **computing technology.**
 
• Intel specializes in developing processors for **personal computers, servers, and mobile devices.**
 
• While Intel plays a significant role in the semiconductor industry, it is not the company collaborating with SiLT in this case.
 
 
 
• **Dell**__
 
 
• **Dell** is a multinational computer technology company known for its **hardware solutions** like laptops, desktops, and servers.
 
• Although Dell is a major player in the technology industry, its expertise lies more in **hardware manufacturing** rather than semiconductor or processor development.
